purpose: Synthetic falsification of unsafe file interpretation shortcuts; not a production importer/security/capacity proof

outcomes.name: comma_split_is_not_csv
outcomes.observation: Quoted comma-containing names and cities are two cells, not four.

outcomes.name: physical_lines_are_not_records
outcomes.observation: Physical line counting miscounts a multiline address.

outcomes.name: embedded_quotes_roundtrip
outcomes.observation: Doubled quote escaping must survive parsing.

outcomes.name: bom_is_not_header_content
outcomes.observation: A transport BOM must not become part of a mapping key.

outcomes.name: semicolon_is_a_real_dialect
outcomes.observation: The reviewed separator is part of the immutable interpretation.

outcomes.name: tabs_are_a_real_dialect
outcomes.observation: Tab-delimited exports need explicit supported dialect handling.

outcomes.name: wrong_dialect_can_parse_without_error
outcomes.observation: Syntactic parsing alone does not establish the correct delimiter.

outcomes.name: empty_cell_is_not_empty_row
outcomes.observation: An absent email and a wholly blank row are different outcomes.

outcomes.name: dict_mapping_can_destroy_duplicate_columns
outcomes.observation: Headers require ordinal identities; converting directly to a dictionary loses the first column.

outcomes.name: ragged_rows_need_validation
outcomes.observation: Parser success can leave unmapped extra cells.

outcomes.name: broken_quotes_are_not_repaired_by_guess
outcomes.observation: Malformed quoting requires a structural correction, not silent row reconstruction.

outcomes.name: invalid_utf8_does_not_justify_replacement
outcomes.observation: Replacement decoding destroys a supplied name while appearing successful.

outcomes.name: legacy_encoding_requires_named_interpretation
outcomes.observation: An explicitly selected supported encoding can preserve the source; detection is not proof.

outcomes.name: leading_zero_identifier_is_text
outcomes.observation: Numeric conversion destroys source identity and postal/phone formatting.

outcomes.name: floating_point_is_not_identifier_storage
outcomes.observation: Binary floating point loses a supplied 17-digit identifier; this is not a simulation of Excel.

outcomes.name: title_case_is_not_name_cleanup
outcomes.observation: Automatic title casing changes a valid supplied name.

outcomes.name: full_name_does_not_imply_family_name
outcomes.observation: A fixed first/last split cannot reconstruct international name structure.

outcomes.name: plus_address_stripping_conflates_values
outcomes.observation: Import transport must not invent provider-specific identity normalization.

outcomes.name: csv_quoting_does_not_remove_formula_prefix
outcomes.observation: Correct CSV escaping preserves the formula-looking text; spreadsheet execution is a separate risk.

outcomes.name: plus_phone_is_not_an_attack_to_strip
outcomes.observation: Security at export/render boundaries must not corrupt valid international phone text.

outcomes.name: formula_cache_can_disagree_with_formula
outcomes.observation: A parser can read an outdated/incorrect cached result; it cannot certify recalculation.

outcomes.name: missing_cache_is_not_empty_contact_value
outcomes.observation: No cached result is distinguishable from an intentionally empty string.

outcomes.name: hidden_rows_remain_in_file
outcomes.observation: Iterating XML cells ignores the user's visible-sheet view unless visibility is explicitly handled.

outcomes.name: merged_cells_do_not_supply_repeated_facts
outcomes.observation: A merged region does not authorize copying its value into every covered contact row.

outcomes.name: declared_dimensions_are_not_observed_cell_count
outcomes.observation: Sparse dimensions must not allocate the worksheet's maximum rectangular grid.

outcomes.name: rich_text_runs_are_one_text_value
outcomes.observation: Discarding later runs silently truncates a contact field.

outcomes.name: explicit_text_output_has_no_formula_element
outcomes.observation: Typed XLSX text is structurally distinct from a formula; no spreadsheet application was executed.

outcomes.name: compressed_size_is_not_resource_size
outcomes.observation: A small input can expand by more than 100x; enforce actual streamed expanded-byte budgets.

outcomes.name: archive_paths_need_validation
outcomes.observation: A ZIP member name is untrusted; the probe never extracts it.

outcomes.name: duplicate_zip_parts_are_ambiguous
outcomes.observation: Different consumers may select different package parts; reject duplicate normalized names.

outcomes.name: xml_declaration_requires_explicit_guard
outcomes.observation: Even a standard parser can expand an internal entity; production must prohibit DTD/entity processing.
